root_cause.text: ttm_bo_access dereferences bo->resource without a NULL check, causing a NULL pointer dereference when a buffer object has been evicted and no longer has a resource associated.
root_cause.evidence: The patch inserts `if (!bo->resource) { ret = -ENODATA; goto unlock; }` before the switch statement that accesses `bo->resource->mem_type`, preventing the dereference of a NULL pointer. The CVE description confirms evicted BOs exist without a resource.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a null check for bo->resource to prevent null pointer dereference in ttm_bo_access.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional check for bo->resource being NULL, setting ret to -ENODATA and jumping to unlock label.
intent_record.how: Prevents null pointer dereference when accessing bo->resource->mem_type by returning an error if bo->resource is NULL.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add unlock label to support goto-based cleanup, fixing potential lock leakage in error paths.
intent_record.what: Added a label 'unlock:' before the call to ttm_bo_unreserve(bo) in the ttm_bo_access function.
intent_record.how: The label enables error handling code to jump via goto to the ttm_bo_unreserve call, ensuring the buffer object is always unlocked even when early returns occur.
